summary: Content Performance Analysis endpoints testing complete - 16/16 backend tests passed. All three endpoints working correctly: Instagram content-performance (shopsevora), YouTube content-performance (MrBeast), and Contact content-performance (combined analysis).
seed_data_creation: TEST_ prefixed contacts created and cleaned up during test execution
context_for_next_testing_agent: Content Performance Analysis endpoints fully working. Test with shopsevora (Instagram) and MrBeast (YouTube) as reference handles.

GET /api/marketing/v2/influencer-analyti.details: Returns best_performing_posts, engagement_by_content_type (IMAGE, VIDEO, CAROUSEL_ALBUM), posting_frequency with consistency_score (0-100), peak_engagement_times with best_hours/best_days/recommendation
Returns best_performing_videos, upload_frequency with consistency_score (0-100), peak_upload_times with best_hours/best_days/recommendation

GET /api/marketing/v2/contacts/{contact_.details: Returns combined Instagram+YouTube analysis with insights and recommendations. Requires contact with social handles, returns 400 if no handles, 404 if contact not found.

engagement_by_content_type structure.details: Contains IMAGE, VIDEO, CAROUSEL_ALBUM keys with count, avg_engagement_rate, max_engagement_rate, min_engagement_rate

peak_engagement_times/peak_upload_times.details: Contains best_hours (array of 'HH:00' strings), best_days (array of day names), recommendation (string)

Authentication requirements.details: All three endpoints require marketing auth (401/403 without token)

Error handling.details: Invalid usernames/channels return {success: false, error: 'message'}, non-existent contacts return 404, contacts without handles return 400

observations.instagram_video_highest_engagement: VIDEO content type has highest avg engagement rate (13.51%) for shopsevora
observations.youtube_upload_frequency: MrBeast uploads 1.9 videos/week with 75% consistency score
observations.insights_generation: Contact content-performance auto-generates insights like 'Instagram: VIDEO content performs best' and recommendations like 'Post on Wednesday around 11:00'
